results.name: Pokedex Phone Case
results.description:
Phone case from the popular video game Pokemon. The back opens up to reveal the inside of the Pokedex. Modeled in Fusion 360, printed in red PLA and colored with permanent paint pens.
 
My first CAD project! After perusing online courses on CAD design, I decided the best way for me to learn was by jumping in and trying to model something. Many failed attempts and poorly thought-out dimensions later, I was able to print and make this Pokedex phone case. This project holds a special place in my heart as the first project I ever brought from CAD to reality.

results.name: Old landline phone
results.description:
Hi everyone!
This is a game ready landline phone model that can be used in computer games.
I've been working on an optimized grid, detailed textures, and a model that was created for the Sub-div.
In the process of creation, I wanted to reflect the realistic textures of rusty metal covered with paint, I hope I succeeded.
The model has 5386 triangles, 3033 vertices. Textures for the model - 2048 - 2048 - the main part, 512 - 256 - the wire from the handset to the case.
